prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1367; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision sustained while the patient was turning left at an intersection. Presenting complaints included neck pain with restricted cervical range of motion, low back pain with paraspinal muscle tenderness, and intermittent headaches described as tension-type in quality. Neurological examination was within normal limits, with no radicular symptoms, motor deficits, or reflex changes noted. Imaging was not required at initial evaluation given the absence of red-flag findings.

Treatment over the course of care comprised 14 visits and included manual therapy, targeted therapeutic exercise for cervical and lumbar stabilization, posture education, and the use of moist heat and gentle soft-tissue mobilization. Pain levels and range of motion improved steadily across the treatment period. At the most recent evaluation, the patient reported substantial reduction in neck and back discomfort, improved tolerance for sitting and driving, and a return to most daily activities with only occasional stiffness after prolonged positioning.

Diagnosis: cervical strain and lumbar strain secondary to the collision. Prognosis is good with continued home exercise. Follow-up care is recommended on an as-needed basis.
